translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content: Nkunga Davidi kuidi pfumu minyimbidi ; mu thangu mbikuidi Natani kayiza kuidi Davidi mu kitsuza kiandi ayi Betaseba.

content.text: A Nzambi, wumboni kiadi
boso buididi luzolo luaku lu ngolo ;
boso buididi kiadi kiaku kinneni,
kubula zinzimbala ziama.
Sukula mambimbi mama moso.
Ayi wuphedisa mu disumu diama.
Bila nzebi zinzimbala ziama
ayi disumu diama didi ku ntualꞌama mu zithangu zioso.
Kuidi ngeyo, veka kaka ndivodidi masumu ;
ayi ndivengi mambimbi va meso maku ;
muingi wumonika wusonga mu thangu wutuba
ayi wukambulu zimbala mu thangu wunsambisa
Bukiedika, minu ndidi nkua masumu tona mu mbutukulu ;
nkua masumu tona thangu ngudi ama kabaka buemba buama.
Bukiedika ngeyo tidi ti kiedika kiba mu khati ku nitu.
Wundonga nduenga mu khati yi ntimꞌama
Wuphedisa mu isopi buna ma ndivedila ;
wutsukula buna ndiela ba wuphembi
viokila mvula yi matadi ma phembi ;
Bika ndimona khini ayi ndiyangalala
Bika mimvesi miomi wukosikisa mi yangalala.
Sueka zizi kiaku va ntuala masumu mama
ayi kubula mbimbi ama yoso.
Vanga mu minu ntima wuvedila, a Nzambi
ayi buela kitula mu minu pheve yimona ayi yikinda.
Kadi kukhuka va ntuala zizi kiaku ;
kadi botula pheve aku yinlongo mu minu.
Wuphutudila khini yi phulusu aku
ayi bika wuphana Pheve yi luzolo lu mboti muingi yikhindisa.
Buna ndiela longa zinzila ziaku
kuidi bobo beti vanga zinzimbala,
ayi bankua masumu bela vutuka kuidi ngeyo.
Wuphukisa mu nzimbala yi menga, a Nzambi
Nzambi yoyi yeti kuphukisa,
ayi ludimi luama luela yimbidila busonga buaku.
A Yave zibula bididi biama,
ayi munuꞌama wela yamikisa nzitusu aku.
Ngeyo wuzolanga ko makaba,
bila enati buawu ; nganu ndinatina mawu ;
ayi wumonanga khini ko mu makaba mayoko.
Makaba ma Nzambi madi pheve yi kosakana
ntima wukosakana ayi wu kiadi
a Nzambi, wulendi ku milenza ko.
Mu diambu di mamboti maku,
bika wuvangila Sioni mamboti,
tunga diaka bibaka bi Yelusalemi.
Kuna kuela ba makaba ma busonga,
makaba mayoko mamvimba meti kumonisa khini.
Buna zingombi zimbakala ziela tambuku va ntalꞌaku.
